name: Modulen IBD Powdered Nutritional Formula (Nestle)
whyItWorks: Specifically developed for Crohn's disease dietary management and Exclusive Enteral Nutrition (EEN). Rich in naturally occurring bioactive TGF-beta 2, a cytokine demonstrated in clinical trials to reduce mucosal inflammation and promote gut mucosal healing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix measured scoops with cool filtered water using a shaker bottle or blender on low speed. Do not boil or use hot liquids to protect the delicate TGF-beta proteins.
